The Poker QA team works in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with developers and product owners as one team. In this role, you will lead and contribute to complex technical projects that require a deep understanding of our product and system architecture. If you enjoy new challenges and want to develop your technical skills, join us!
We are looking for a talented QA Engineer to join our Poker QA team, part of a global group with colleagues in Israel and other locations. You will execute and track manual client-server tests for Poker products across PC, Mac and mobile platforms, from test environments through to production. You will benefit from a hybrid work model, combining office days with remote work throughout the week.
 What You'll Be Doing
Perform client-server testing across company products, including post-production testing.
Execute acceptance, progression/functional, system, GUI, sanity and regression tests.
Manage the full QA lifecycle: design test cases, execute manual and automated tests, analyse results, report and track defects, and determine when testing is complete. Monitor and support Poker features after their launch into production.
 Job Requirements
 Who We're Looking For
At least 2 years of experience in manual client-server testing.
Experience using AI tools for QA testing.
Experience with MS SQL and the ability to write basic queries—mandatory.
Knowledge of defect and test management tools, including TFS, Jira, MTM and QC.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities.
The ability to learn quickly, understand processes and work independently to develop an end-to-end understanding of the system.
Strong technical troubleshooting skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Familiarity with mobile testing.
 Nice to have
A degree in Computer Science or an equivalent qualification.
Familiarity with testing and working in an Agile environment.
Experience using sniffer tools.
Experience working with web services (APIs) using SoapUI and Swagger.
Knowledge of Poker.
Knowledge of automation, including QTP, script writing or code-based automation.
